name: Panvel
registryBasis: Maharashtra’s official Land Records Department lists the Panvel Sub-Superintendent of Land Records office and reports 15,386 property cards among Raigad city-survey records for Panvel. The state’s official BhuNaksha map interface is a parcel-map candidate, but its app redirected in a loop and no anonymous safe feature schema was verified. The city’s NAKSHA/drone survey references do not by themselves prove parcel-vector availability at the WUP point.
scopeLimits: City-specific source discovery only. No parcel geometry was retained. Citywide/countrywide completeness, title, survey accuracy, and runtime suitability are not asserted. No owner, address, account/tax identifier, credentials, or token values were requested or retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Official viewer could not be inspected past its redirect loop; no schema-safe geometry endpoint or feature was verified. No property-specific lookup or bypass was attempted.
remainingUncertainty: Whether BhuNaksha exposes anonymous vector geometry for this Panvel point, and which surveyed record unit applies, remain unresolved.
nextStep: If a primary official map service can be identified later, inspect its metadata and safe key fields before any bounded geometry-only request.
